description: Drain (default) or peek one agent's mailbox on one team. Drained messages move to mailbox/<agent>/archive; concurrent drains never return the same message twice. Use when native SendMessage is wrong because there is no host-agnostic inbox to read from — this is the Grok/Codex-side counterpart to team_send for hosts without a live message channel.

agent.description: Agent name whose inbox to read

peek.description: If true, do not archive/drain messages

name: team_inbox
